name: Gear Lever
description: AppImage-update: HTTPS metadata but no crypto payload verification before chmod +x and run; user can also configure plaintext HTTP/FTP sources (→D).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Gear Lever manages AppImage updates through configured update sources. The inspected source selection accepts HTTP and HTTPS, and uses zsync SHA-1 for update detection; a complete publisher-authentication policy remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release; source review does not establish server metadata authenticity or every updater provider's behavior.
